name: ESIC (Employees' State Insurance)
description: Social security and health insurance scheme for workers in covered establishments (medical, sickness, maternity, disability benefits).
eligibility: Employees with wage up to Rs. 21,000/month (Rs. 25,000 for persons with disability) in ESIC-covered factories/establishments.
benefits: Cashless medical care for worker and family, sickness/maternity benefits, disability and dependent benefits.
application_mode: Employer enrols; employee uses ESIC portal / dispensaries
application_steps: Employer registers establishment and enrols employees (Form 1).
Avail treatment at ESIC dispensary/hospital with card.
processing_time: Enrolment by employer; benefits as per claim processing.
fees: Contribution by employer (3.25%) and employee (0.75%) on wages.
validity: Coverage while in covered employment; continue via scheme provisions.
office_locator_info: ESIC dispensaries, hospitals, and regional offices.

faq.q: What is the wage ceiling for ESIC?

ai_summary: ESIC provides medical and cash benefits to covered workers (wage <= Rs. 21,000) via employer enrolment.
ai_explanation: ESIC is a contributory social insurance scheme where employer and employee contribute a percentage of wages. Covered workers and their families get cashless medical care plus sickness, maternity, and disability benefits. Enrolment is done by the employer.
